name: lifestart-clinic-app
description: LifeStart Weight Loss Clinic Management System

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && cp -n .env.example .env || true && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
